suggestions.title: Optimize LCP Image Loading
suggestions.description: The main LCP element is a hero image that could benefit from optimization to improve load times.
suggestions.implementation: Modify the hero image setup in `scripts.js` or `aem.js` to apply loading='eager' and fetchpriority='high' using JavaScript.

suggestions.title: Defer Third-party Scripts
suggestions.description: The `auth0-spa-js.production.js` file is introducing significant delay in loading.
suggestions.implementation: Modify the script inclusion from the HTML head to be loaded via `loadDelayed` function in `scripts.js`.

suggestions.title: Code Splitting and Tree-Shaking
suggestions.description: Excessive unused code in `scripts.js` and `aem.js` is affecting load performance.
suggestions.implementation: Refactor `aem.js` and `scripts.js` to apply code splitting on heavily-used sections.
